title: Credit Card - To Churn or HODL?
body:
Currently only hold CBA Diamond Card which is/was my Keep card for all the direct debits and subs etc.
Looking to rescope and seek out points whore mode again but the churning days don't seem to be as golden as they used to be.
Using the https://www.rwrds.com.au/credit-card-eligibility-rules/check… looks like I can do all except Westpac currently.
I'm open to either Qantas or Velocity but wondering if there's better value to be had in the non FF Points and having the flexibility to transfer for Gift Card or cashback etc considering the OCT changes.
Essentially;
Do you still have a "keep" card and churn/burn big spends on the sign up offers still?
and do you feel that the annual fee's = reward worthyness.
(Yet to confirm if I can re-sign up with Mycard for their offer as they're extremely vague on the resign up as I got palmed off to them with Citibank changing hands - I closed that in JAN26 if anyone knows).
